entities.summary: Hussein-Ali Montazeri Najafabadi was an Iranian cleric, politician, theologian, writer, and activist who was the first and only deputy supreme leader of Iran from 1985 until his resignation in 1989. A reformist, he was one of the major figures of the Iranian Revolution and one of the highest-ranking authorities in Shia Islam.
